name: quality-skills
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：quality-skills。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Six agent skills for the quality loop — tests that can actually fail, graded review findings, metrics with a source, regression diagnosis, debt order, and the ship decision. Severity and blocking stay separate.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
